text: Each program instance shall have an environment-owned coordinator and designated lifecycle agent, with states bootstrap, initializing, running, shutting_down, and terminated. Normal initialization shall proceed in that order; failed initialization shall proceed to shutdown then termination. A terminal fault may terminate directly from any state without orderly cleanup.
